checkpoint_finding.rule: A future local state is target-label-unexposed only when expression preprocessing, graph construction, contrastive fitting, PCA or clustering, refinement, and any deconvolution reference are restricted to the registered participant split.

input_eligibility.gse192741: Visium expression and coordinates are structurally compatible, but four donors and unresolved hg19 annotation permit only future technical fixtures.
input_eligibility.gse292268: CosMx expression and coordinates are structurally compatible as a separate resolution stratum, but donor joins are unresolved and four donors are underpowered.
input_eligibility.hra007511: Visium RNA could be used only after permission, participant and section joins, rights, and runtime admission. H&E and adjacent-section MALDI are not native inputs.
input_eligibility.vu2025: Visium RNA could be used only after the DSA and participant map clear. Graphs may not span the multiple participants sharing one VLP array.

exposure_and_leakage_findings.native_fit: GraphST trains an autoencoder and contrastive objective on the supplied target expression and coordinate graph, then usually fits PCA and a partition on the target. This is transductive.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.preprocessing: The source can normalize, log-transform, choose HVGs, and scale the supplied target when HVGs are absent. Those operations cannot precede participant splitting.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.graph: The graph must be participant- and section-blocked. Concatenating coordinates can connect donors or tissue sections.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.clustering: PCA, mclust, Leiden or Louvain, cluster number or resolution, and spatial refinement are target-fit choices and cannot use held labels.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.deconvolution: The deconvolution path jointly learns a mapping between target spots and a single-cell reference. It is transductive and does not create observed cell-to-spot pairs.

known_incidents_and_biases: The pinned repository contains AGPL-3.0 license text while setup.py and PyPI metadata declare MIT. Execution, adaptation, and redistribution are blocked pending rightsholder clarification.
PyPI 1.1.1 artifacts do not bind the selected 2024 source commit.
The GitHub V1.0.0 release and linked Zenodo record identify DeepST rather than the selected GraphST implementation and cannot serve as its archive receipt.
The 10x graph builder computes dense all-pairs distances and adjacency, creating quadratic memory risk.
There is no pretrained state, frozen held-donor adapter, or complete native export contract.
Target refinement and deconvolution can make a strong in-sample partition without demonstrating participant-held transfer.
remaining_blockers: Obtain written rightsholder clarification identifying the license for the exact selected revision and obligations for execution, modification, trained state, and redistribution.
Obtain a rights-cleared powered participant-linked spatial RNA dataset, registered endpoint, transcript-native baselines, and external source.

Define separate native-transductive and benchmark-defined frozen lanes. Freeze preprocessing, participant-blocked graphs, feature order, cluster selection, refinement, and reference deconvolution inside development partitions.
Replace or bound the dense all-pairs graph path and prove numeric parity on a fixed fixture before admitting large sections.
Resolve a complete exact environment and safe tensor-only state export; do not use untrusted serialized objects.
After rights and data activation plus campaign approval, pass SLURM import, graph-boundary, memory, forward, backward, resume, deterministic seed, node-order, no-network, and cross-device fixtures.
interpretation: GraphST is a future target-fitted spatial RNA comparator rather than a pretrained inductive model. Its contamination surface is local preprocessing, graph construction, target training, clustering, refinement, and optional deconvolution. A direct license conflict blocks even execution, and no eligible spatial task or hold back exists.
